---
name: Optional Linux or hardware validation
about: Share exactly what was tested without implying broad compatibility
---

Hardware writes are optional. Report read-only or simulator results if that is all you tested. Do not expose serial numbers or private data.

### Environment

- Ajazz Linux version/commit:
- Linux distro/version, architecture and kernel:
- Python/Qt versions; X11/Wayland:
- Mouse model and VID/PID (omit serial):
- Cable, receiver or both:
- Permission setup, if changed:

### Checks actually performed

- Demo mode:
- Discovery and read-only status/settings:
- UI behavior and local save/reload:
- Explicit Apply / playback / unplug-replug persistence, only if you chose to test:

### Results and remaining UNKNOWNs

Include exact steps, observed errors and whether recovery/reconnect was needed. A read-only success does not validate writes; a single environment does not establish support for every Linux system.
